name: week
title: Year-end week
subtitle: Fictional demo or your selected database. Read-only.

sections.title: Due dates
sections.note: Every file not yet issued, soonest first. A negative days to due is overdue.
sections.sql: select code as file,client,status,preparer,partner,due_on,days_to_due,return_due_on from engagement_status where status<>'issued' order by due_on,code

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from (select 'Accounts overdue' as issue,code as record,preparer as owner,due_on as due from engagement_status where status<>'issued' and due_on<current_date union all select 'Client query overdue',code,owner,due_on from queries where status='open' and due_on<current_date union all select 'Review point open',r.code,e.preparer,r.raised_on from review_points r join engagements e on e.id=r.engagement_id where r.status='open') x order by due

sections.title: Ready for the partner
sections.note: Reviewed files and anything still holding sign-off.
sections.sql: select s.code as file,s.client,s.terms_missing,(s.minimum_requirements_apply and (trim(e.tax_reconciliation_reference)='' or trim(e.associated_persons_reference)='')) as nz_references_missing from engagement_status s join engagements e on e.id=s.id where s.status='reviewed' order by s.code

sections.title: Where each file stands
sections.sql: select code as file,client,status,tb_difference_cents,unmapped_lines,unprepared_workpapers,unreviewed_workpapers,open_queries,open_review_points,proposed_adjustments,unexplained_movements,currency from engagement_status order by code

sections.title: Profit against last year
sections.sql: select engagement as file,currency,prior_profit_cents,profit_cents,(profit_cents-prior_profit_cents) as change_cents from performance_summary order by engagement

sections.title: Movements over materiality without a workpaper
sections.sql: select engagement as file,label as line,currency,prior_cents,current_cents,movement_cents from movements where not explained order by engagement,line

sections.title: Client queries open
sections.sql: select q.code,e.code as file,q.owner,q.asked_on,q.due_on,q.question from queries q join engagements e on e.id=q.engagement_id where q.status='open' order by q.due_on

sections.title: Review points open
sections.sql: select r.code,e.code as file,r.workpaper,r.raised_by,r.raised_on,r.point from review_points r join engagements e on e.id=r.engagement_id where r.status='open' order by r.raised_on

sections.title: Workpapers waiting
sections.sql: select e.code as file,w.code as workpaper,w.title,case when w.prepared_on is null then 'to prepare' else 'to review' end as stage from workpapers w join engagements e on e.id=w.engagement_id where w.reviewed_on is null and e.status in ('open','prepared') order by e.code,w.code
